Homemade Alfredo Sauce
By: Mandee Pogue
Published: Saturday, May 17, 2014 - 8:04pm

Ingredients




•1 stick of butter
•1 pint of heavy cream
•1 tbsp. garlic
•2 c. of grated parmesan cheese

Preparation

1 1.Melt butter in sauce pan. 2 2.Add garlic and cook until you smell it coming from the pan. 3 3.Add cream. 4 4.Just before cream comes to a boil, add cheese while stirring. 5 5.Stir, on low, until smooth and creamy. 6 6.Taste and add Salt and Pepper as needed. 7 7.Serve over your favorite pasta or chicken. 8 8.Enjoy!

About

Of all the things we buy in a jar, Alfredo sauce shouldn't be one of them.  With just a few simple ingredients and 10 minutes of your time, you can have out-of-this-world Alfredo sauce made in your very own kitchen!
Give this recipe a try and there will be no going back!
